extensionDescription.message: Archives old messages using Thunderbird's configured Archive action.

intro.message: Once a day, archive messages older than the selected age using each account's Thunderbird Archive settings.

deleteSpamTrash.message: Delete old email in Spam and Trash

deleteWarning.message: Messages older than the selected age will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.

exclusionsText.message: Archive and its subfolders, Trash, Junk, Drafts, Templates and Outbox. Spam and Trash are cleaned only when the option above is enabled.

invalidCustomDays.message: Enter a custom value of at least 1 day.

archivingStatus.message: Archiving old messages… Keep Thunderbird open.
